female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

monthly-income-slower-general.title: Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
monthly-income-slower-general.body: The inclusion of precise monthly income amounts is associated with slower funding speeds for both male and female borrowers.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

asset-ownership-faster.title: Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
asset-ownership-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference owning a home, a store, or other business assets tend to fund faster for both men and women.

family-responsibilities-slower-general.title: Mentioning family responsibilities or supporting family members predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
family-responsibilities-slower-general.body: Pitches that reference household duties or the need to support family members are associated with slower funding speeds for both men and women.

female-aspirational-language-faster.title: Female borrowers who use aspirational language such as 'dreams' for their business fund faster.
female-aspirational-language-faster.body: Pitches from women that reference dreams or striving for a better future in the context of their business are associated with increased funding speed.

loan-history-faster-general.title: Mentioning a history of successful loan repayment or previous profits predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
loan-history-faster-general.body: Pitches that reference previous loan success or previous season profits are associated with increased funding speed for both men and women.

female-working-hours-faster.body: Female borrowers who specify exact daily working hours may fund faster.

female-gratitude-faster.body: Female borrowers who express direct gratitude to lenders may fund faster.

female-narrative-templates-slower.body: Female borrowers who use identical narrative templates in their pitches may fund more slowly.

female-specific-child-needs-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention specific needs for children beyond general education may fund faster.

female-inventory-items-faster.body: Female borrowers who list specific types of inventory items may fund faster.

female-age-faster.body: Female borrowers who include their specific age in the pitch may fund faster.

female-years-experience-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention their total years of experience in their business may fund faster.

female-local-currency-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention the loan amount in local currency may fund more slowly.

female-family-needs-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention providing for family needs may fund faster.

female-assets-history-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention assets or financial history may fund slower.

female-specific-inventory-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific inventory items like canned goods or personal care products may fund faster.

female-new-business-hardship-slower.title: Female borrowers who focus on starting a new business while emphasizing hardship may fund more slowly.

female-local-currency-faster.title: Female borrowers who list the loan amount in local currency may fund faster.
female-local-currency-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation of faster funding with local currency

female-higher-php-amount-faster.title: Female borrowers who request higher PHP amounts may fund faster.

female-nwtf-php-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention both the NWTF institution and the loan amount in PHP may fund slower.
female-nwtf-php-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that local currency predicts faster funding

female-input-benefits-faster.title: Female borrowers who describe specific benefits of requested inputs may fund faster.

female-husband-income-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention their husband's employment or income may fund faster.

female-hardworking-faster.title: Female borrowers who describe themselves as hardworking may fund faster.

female-reinvesting-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention reinvesting earnings into their business may fund faster.
